children: Immersive events at the new Solei Beach Club, seasonal dining and a charitable giveback bring a fresh take on the season to South Beach
MIAMI BEACH, Fla., Sept. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Fall looks a little different in Miami Beach. This year,
is trading falling leaves for swaying palms with a spirited collection of experiences across its newly opened
and signature restaurant,
. From interactive murder mysteries and Halloween movies under the stars to fall specials and a charitable giveback, the oceanfront hotel is bringing a fresh take on fall to South Beach.

Since opening in May, Solei Beach Club has brought the effortless spirit of coastal Spain to Surfcomber's oceanfront, pairing Mediterranean influence with South Beach energy. Now entering its first fall season, Solei serves as a new backdrop for the hotel's seasonal programming, giving locals and hotel guests even more ways to gather, celebrate and experience Surfcomber by the sea.
"Fall is such a fun time at Surfcomber because it gives us an opportunity to put our own Miami Beach spin on the season," said
Mohan Koka, General Manager of Kimpton Surfcomber Hotel
. "This year, we're bringing together great food and creative experiences, giving both our guests and local community plenty of reasons to celebrate with us throughout the season."
Halloween Murder Mystery Dinners at Solei Beach Club
October 10, 17 & 24 at 8 p.m.
Following its debut last year, Surfcomber's
Halloween Murder Mystery Dinner Series

returns by popular demand with a new seaside setting at Solei Beach Club. Across three interactive evenings, guests will step directly into the story as secrets unravel, suspects emerge and everyone plays a role in solving the night's crime.
This year's mysteries include:
Murder at the School of Mystery
on October 10, a wizarding-world whodunit
The Witches Pact
on October 17, centered around a deadly broken bond within the Midnight Coven
A Killer Evening: Sip, Dine and Solve a Crime
on October 24, a playful nod to the classic game
Clue
Each evening features a decadent three-course menu:
Witches Garden Harvest Salad
with roasted butternut squash, goat cheese, candied pecans and maple apple cider vinaigrette
The Headless Horseman's Feast
, crispy herb-roasted chicken with pumpkin Parmesan risotto and sage brown butter jus
The Poisoned Apple
for dessert, with roasted cinnamon apple, mascarpone mousse, salted caramel and vanilla ice cream
The experience also includes two cocktails: the
Sunset Rider
, made with Deep Eddy Vodka, Giffard Pêche, blood orange, Grand Marnier and lemon, and the
Amigo Verde
, featuring Tequila Ocho Plata, Ancho Reyes Verde, Green Chartreuse and lime. Additional cocktails available for purchase include
Lil Shrubs
and
Rise & Shine
. Tickets are $150++ per person and include the three-course dinner, two cocktails and interactive experience. Click HERE to book.
Halloween Movies Under the Stars
October 16, 23 & 30 at 8 p.m.
Solei will also become an open-air cinema for a new
Halloween Movie Night Series
, inviting locals and hotel guests to settle in beneath the palms for three nostalgic Halloween favorites:
Ghostbusters
on October 16,
Beetlejuice
on October 23 and
Hocus Pocus

on October 30. Guests are encouraged to bring their own chairs or towels, while a movie-theater-inspired menu of popcorn, nachos, hot dogs and chicken tenders will be available à la carte. Tickets are $10 for adults and $5 for children 12 and under and include a bag of popcorn. Click HERE to book.
Rosé for a Cause at Solei

Throughout October, Solei will turn its signature rosé—an exclusive bottling created with DAOU Vineyards to channel the energy and elegance of the Marbella coast—into an opportunity to give back in recognition of Breast Cancer Awareness Month. A portion of sales from every purchase of Solei Rosé will benefit the Susan G. Komen Breast Cancer Foundation, supporting awareness and research.
"What I love about this lineup is that there are different reasons to come back throughout the month," said
Victoria Palacio, Marketing Manager of Kimpton Surfcomber Hotel

. "You can make a night of the murder mystery, come back for a movie under the stars or simply stop in for a seasonal bite, and Rosé for a Cause gives us a meaningful way to support the community along the way."
Fall Flavors at The Social Club
September 22 – December 21
At
The Social Club,
the hotel's signature restaurant known for its ingredient-driven cuisine and South of France-inspired setting,
Executive Chef Gastón Javier
will introduce a limited selection of fall specials, available September 22 through December 21:
Butternut Squash Arancini
with smoked mozzarella, Parmesan and brown butter sage aioli
Maple-Miso Glazed Salmon
with sweet potato purée, charred Brussels sprouts, apple-fennel salad and cider beurre blanc
Pumpkin Waffle & Hot Honey Chicken
, for brunch, pairing a pumpkin-spiced Belgian waffle with crispy chicken, cinnamon whipped butter, maple hot honey and pickled apple
At the bar,
The Toasted Flame
combines RumChata, vanilla vodka and cinnamon whiskey for a cocktail that channels the warmer flavors of fall—even when temperatures outside remain decidedly tropical.

The seasonal fun extends beyond the menu, with The Social Club serving up even more reasons to gather throughout the week—from daily bottomless brunch cocktails and weekday happy hours to the return of a Friday night favorite:
Happy Hour | Sunday–Thursday, 5–7 p.m.
– Kick off the evening with $12 cocktails and light bites, including watermelon sushi, tuna tartare and croquettes, alongside $10 wines and $7 beers.
Bottomless Cocktails | Daily Brunch
– Keep the cocktails flowing at brunch with two hours of bottomless Bloody Marys, Aperol Spritzes, margaritas, mimosas and Santi Spritzes for $39 per person.
Shaken After Dark Returns | Fridays, 5–10 p.m.

– Back for the season, The Social Club's Friday night martini ritual brings $10 martinis to the bar all evening long. Guests can sip their way through espresso martinis, dirty martinis, cosmopolitans, French martinis and lemon drops, making Fridays the perfect excuse to stay out a little later.
For more information on Kimpton Surfcomber Hotel and its fall programming, visit surfcomber.com. For reservations and additional information, visit soleibeachclub.com and socialclubatsurfcomber.com.

ABOUT KIMPTON SURFCOMBER HOTEL

Managed by Kimpton Hotels & Restaurants, Surfcomber sits along 200 feet of Atlantic Oceanfront in the heart of South Beach's Art Deco District on historic Collins Avenue. The fully renovated hotel offers direct beach access, a relaxed, design-driven "backyard bliss" experience, signature restaurant The Social Club and the newly opened, coastal Spain-inspired Solei Beach Club. At Surfcomber, guests enjoy the perfect quartet of sun, surf, sand and social.
